name: Monorepo-Bench
intro: Monorepo-Bench 是 GPT-5.3-Codex 系统卡披露的 OpenAI 内部大型仓库软件工程评测；每个样本从改动前分支开始，由智能体按人工编写的拉取请求式提示修改代码，并以隐藏单元测试是否全部通过判定成功。
build_method: 内部大型仓库, 人工编写拉取请求式提示与线索, 人工编写隐藏单元测试
metric: 成功率（全部任务专用隐藏测试通过）
task_type: 软件工程, 大型仓库任务
eval_feature: 改动前分支环境, 智能体式编码, CLI 与 Python, 全测试通过门槛
build_method_en: Internal Large Repository, Human-written PR-style Prompts and Hints, Human-written Hidden Unit Tests
eval_feature_en: Pre-change Branch Environment, Agentic Coding, CLI and Python, All-tests-pass Gate
intro_en: Monorepo-Bench is OpenAI's in-house large-repository software-engineering evaluation disclosed in the GPT-5.3-Codex system card; each sample starts from a pre-change branch, asks an agent to implement a human-written pull-request-style request, and succeeds only when all hidden unit tests pass.
metric_en: Success Rate (all task-specific hidden tests pass)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official GPT-5.3-Codex System Card Section 5.1.3.1 and Table 6. The diagram preserves the disclosed real-world software- and research-engineering scope, human-written PR-style change requests, hints, and hidden unit tests, pre-change branch checkout, agentic CLI/Python rollout, final code modification, all-task-specific-tests-pass success gate, and aggregate success-rate comparison. It explicitly marks task count and selection as undisclosed and does not invent a Pass@1 label or partial-credit scheme.
